## Activity

During March 2021, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 30 captures. Activity was completed in line with the planned service arrangements. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. There were no reported operational issues affecting the overall delivery of the scheduled activity.

The recorded activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month. The figures should be considered alongside the small number of images that were not suitable for grading and the time taken to complete grading.

## Image quality

Of the 30 captures, 1 was ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 3.3 per cent. The result indicates that most captures were suitable for assessment. The ungradable capture has been included in the monthly quality figures and should be considered when reviewing image acquisition and session performance.

## Grading

A total of 4 captures were graded as referable. The median grading lag was 1 day. Overall, grading activity was completed with a short median wait, while the referable results identify cases requiring appropriate follow-up under established arrangements. These figures provide the monthly summary for Oakridge Primary Care for March 2021.
